overview: The Lexus ES is a midsize luxury sedan. The ES 300h is the hybrid variant, sharing the Toyota TNGA-K platform with the Camry/Avalon. For 2026, Lexus introduced the all-new 8th-generation ES which adds BEV variants. The 7th-gen 2025 model continues with proven hybrid system. Sources: https://www.lexus.com/models/ES , https://pressroom.lexus.com/all-new-2026-lexus-es/
